# Artem Panteleev

> Independent Digital Designer and Art Director creating websites, visual
> storytelling, cross-media campaigns, key visuals, and digital brand systems
> for global clients.

## Portfolio

- [Homepage](https://www.artyarty.com/): Portfolio overview, selected work, clients,
  employment history, and contact details.

## Case Studies

- [Ozon Education](https://www.artyarty.com/cases/ozon-education): Learning platform
  redesign and scalable visual identity for marketplace sellers.
- [M&M's x Skittles](https://www.artyarty.com/cases/mms-skittles): Interactive movie
  promo campaign, trivia game, website, and animated materials.
- [Snickers](https://www.artyarty.com/cases/snickers): Interactive promo campaign,
  game mechanics, visual system, and animated banners.
- [Sber Tech. Conference](https://www.artyarty.com/cases/sber-tech-conference):
  Platform V conference visual identity and physical event touchpoints.
- [MTS. Contest Website](https://www.artyarty.com/cases/mts-your-business): Grant
  program website, registration flow, editorial layouts, and campaign visuals.
